about: verify never makes a key where none is. A --key-file whose path holds no key is refused, and nothing is made at that path, since a key made on the spot would attest with a key the lock never admitted.
The second head bound asks live, by its own lock's head/second, is run with no key at all: it folds and says what it found, attests nothing, and makes nothing.

cases.name: verify over the tree with --key-file at a path that does not exist
cases.said: verify: REFUSE·key no key at …/no-such-dir/verify.pem: a key made on the spot would attest with a key the lock never admitted
cases.made: nothing: the directory is still absent

cases.name: the second head asked live by bound, with no key
cases.said: VERIFY   agrees · 2539 lines stand here · 2539 in the render · 0 missing · 0 extra · epoch 201 · not attested: no --key-file

red was: a verify key made where a path was missing, which attests with a key nobody admitted
